analysis:
Documentation-only change to docs/developer/test.md: the 'Last updated' date is bumped, a new test script (scripts/test-provider-cluster-runtime-models.py) is added to the release test list, and the release-publication test description gains cluster_runtime block coverage. That covers a 64 KiB registration body bound, ID length limits, and a local-HTTP-registry model-metadata fetch. The supplied head text (lines 1385-2307) is surrounding unchanged test guidance, and the changed ranges at head 1289 and 1325-1340 and 1353-1356 fall outside the supplied text units. I saw only a truncated patch excerpt, so the script and workflow implementations are not visible.

No code, key handling, authorization, attestation or encryption behavior changes in the supplied evidence. The description explicitly says the new tests use no network and read no weights. Relevant threat areas were checked: T-041 (prefix cache) and the TB-011/TB-012 boundaries. The documented text keeps SEC-035 cache-isolation and tenant-partition test guidance, and I found no weakening of security claims. It also does not make deployment or qualification claims beyond local validation, and it repeatedly states that CPU and synthetic checks do not establish production readiness.

Open question for integration: the new cluster_runtime release payload and registration validation live in files outside this batch (release scripts, coordinator limit). Those would need their own review if changed.
